manifest.Name: Ptty PC Monitor
manifest.Description: Shows CPU/GPU temperature and load, RAM usage, internet speed and fan RPM on keys, and adjusts monitor brightness and contrast with Stream Deck + dials. Reading sensors requires the Ptty PC Monitor sensor service to be installed as well.

com.hollobar.ptty-pc-monitor.sensor.Name: Sensor
com.hollobar.ptty-pc-monitor.sensor.Tooltip: Shows CPU/GPU temperature and load, RAM, internet speed or fan RPM.

com.hollobar.ptty-pc-monitor.brightness.Name: Monitor Brightness
com.hollobar.ptty-pc-monitor.brightness.Tooltip: Adjusts monitor brightness and contrast with a Stream Deck + dial (DDC/CI).

strings.pi.name: Name (optional)
strings.pi.layoutHint: Move and resize the label, value, graph area and background image in a separate window.
strings.pi.graphHint: Unit: {unit}. e.g. CPU temperature min 40 / max 90 → 40–90 °C fills the full graph height
strings.pi.pawnioBody: Reading CPU temperature and motherboard fans (CPU fan, case fans) requires the PawnIO driver. Everything else works without it. Install it from the official site whenever you need it; it is picked up automatically within a minute.
strings.pi.usageText:
Turn: adjust the value
Press: switch brightness ↔ contrast
Touch: re-read the current values from the monitor
strings.layout.title: Layout
strings.layout.hintLabel: Drag the label to move it. Drag the white handle up or down, or use the mouse wheel, to resize it.
strings.layout.hintValue: Drag the value and its second line (smaller text) separately. Drag the white handle up or down, or use the mouse wheel, to resize the value.
strings.layout.hintGraph: Drag the blue area to move the graph and use the white handles to resize it. The top edge is where the maximum lands, the bottom edge the minimum.
strings.layout.hintBg: Drag the image to move it and use the corner handles or mouse wheel to resize it. Parts outside the key are shown faded.
strings.layout.hintCrop: The whole image is shown. Only the part inside the white frame is used. Drag the frame to move it and use the handles to resize it.
strings.layout.noOpener: Open this from the Stream Deck settings panel.
